name: Studio Image
description: Pictures from text: a picture is YAML — a stack of layers (shapes, SVG paths, text, pictures, procedural textures, pixel art) with gradients, strokes, shadows, masks, blend modes and filters — rendered to PNG/JPG/WebP/ICO in several sizes with a preview and a report (brightness, contrast, colors, warnings). Posters, covers, logos, icons, banners, seamless textures and sprites for games. Also analyses, converts and packs existing images. Extensible with Python plugins (shapes, filters, textures).
